fields.accordion-title-solutions-html: How does table ordering via QR code work?
fields.rt-faq-html: Your customers sit back and scan the QR code attached to their piste. They consult the menu, place their order in a few clicks and pay with their preferred means of payment (cash, contact or contactless bank card, luncheon vouchers, Apple Pay...). The order then arrives directly on your cash register software and in the kitchen, if you're equipped with a printer or production screen.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-2: Why equip your bowling alley with Innovorder?
fields.rt-faq-html-2: Innovorder centralizes all order points (snack, bar, forecourt) for seamless service, even during peak periods. Our all-in-one ecosystem enables you to reduce queues, improve the productivity of your teams, increase the average basket while offering your customers a memorable moment.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-3: Can I track my activity in real time?
fields.rt-faq-html-3: Yes. Thanks to the Innovorder cash register and its connected tools, you can track your sales in real time by zone (bar, snack bar, lanes), monitor orders in progress, and anticipate peaks in activity.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-4: Why is the Innovorder cash register essential for using our other solutions?
fields.rt-faq-html-4: The Innovorder cash register is the heart of our ecosystem: it centralizes all order data, collects cash and ensures perfect synchronization. It enables you to manage your business easily, and with reliable data.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-5: What solutions are available to equip my bowling alley?
fields.rt-faq-html-5:
Innovorder offers an ecosystem designed specifically for bowling.

  • Cash register: manage your slopes, bar and snack bar simultaneously from a single tool, even at peak times. Our mobile cash register, for example, allows you to cash directly on the slopes.
  • Ordering at the table via QR code: your customers can order without leaving their seat, making for smoother service and higher sales volumes.
  • Order kiosk: ideal at the entrance, near the snack bar or directly on the slopes, to collect orders without overloading your teams and avoiding queues at the counter.
  • Production display (KDS): instantly displays orders in the kitchen or at the bar, for faster, error-free service.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-6: What are the advantages of a mobile cash register?
fields.rt-faq-html-6:
The mobile cash register lets your teams move around freely, taking orders and cashing up directly on the dance floor or at the bar.

This reduces unnecessary travel, improves service time and frees up time for customer relations. It's also a real productivity booster during busy periods.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-7: Can I manage my leads and reservations with Innovorder?
fields.rt-faq-html-7: No, the Innovorder cash register is dedicated to catering management only. It does not manage bowling lanes or reservations. Our solution focuses on cash collection, order taking and smooth service within your catering space.
